## Read in spectrum data 


checking that the spectra data are in the pavo rspec format


```{r, message = F}
spectra_dirs <- list.files('../Spectra/Diffuse irradiance spectra/',
                           pattern = '2 feeder UV')

spectra_list <- lapply(spectra_dirs, function(x){
  path <- paste0('../Spectra/Diffuse irradiance spectra/',x)
  files <- list.files(path)
  spec <- lapply(files, function(y) read_excel(paste(path,y, sep = '/'), 
                                               skip = 1, 
                                               col_names = c("wl","x")))
  df <- Reduce(function(dtf1, dtf2) cbind(dtf1, dtf2[,2]),
        spec)
  samp_names <- str_extract(sapply(c(1:length(files)), 
                        function(z) paste(x, files[z], sep = '-')),
                        "([0-9 A-Za-z]*_)([0-9 A-Za-z-]*)(.xlsx)",
                        group = 2)
  colnames(df) <- c("wl",samp_names)
  df
})

spectra_df <- Reduce(function(dtf1, dtf2) cbind(dtf1, dtf2[,-1]),
        spectra_list)

specs <- as.rspec(spectra_df)
is.rspec(specs)
```

```{r, echo = F}
format = "pipe")
```

## Pavo summaries of the data: original data


```{r, echo = F}

ss <- summary(specs)
summary_descriptions <- c("B1: total brightness","B2: mean brightness", "B3: intensity",
                          "S1U: contribution of UV","S1V: contribution of violet","S1B: contribution of blue",
                          "S1G: contribution of green","S1Y: contribution of yellow","S1R: contribution of red",
                          "S2: spectral saturation","S3:chroma (reflectance * bB / (Rmax+-50nm))",
                          "S4: spectral purity","S5: chroma (segment classification)","S6: contrast",
                          "S7: spectral saturation","S8: chroma ((Rmax-Rmin)/B2)","S9: carotonoid chroma",
                          "S10: peaky chroma","H1: peak wavelength","H2: wavelength at bmaxneg",
                          "H3: wavelength at Rmid","H4: design segment classification","H5:wavelength at Bmax")
names(summary_descriptions) <- colnames(ss)

ssn <- rbind(summary_descriptions, signif(ss, digits = 3))
```



```{r, echo = F}
kable(ssn[c(1,2,10),], 
      format.args = list(scientific = FALSE), 
      #col.names = c("Depth Sum"), 
format = "pipe")
```


## Plots


```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
specs_melt <- melt(specs, id.vars = c("wl"))
specs_melt$group <- str_extract(specs_melt$variable, "[a-zA-Z ]*")
specs_melt$rep <- str_extract(specs_melt$variable, "-[sS]ample [0-9]*")
g <- ggplot(specs_melt, aes(x = wl, y = value, color = rep)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral") +
  facet_grid(~group) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 300), lty = 2, color = "grey")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 700), lty = 2, color = "grey")+
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_prism()
g
```

## Smoothing

For example, just choosing one window/strength

```{r}
specs.sm <- procspec(specs, opt = "smooth", span = 0.05)
```

## Plot smoothed data

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=5, echo = F}
specs.sm_melt <- melt(specs.sm, id.vars = c("wl"))
specs.sm_melt$group <- str_extract(specs.sm_melt$variable, "[a-zA-Z ]*")
specs.sm_melt$rep <- factor(str_extract(specs_melt$variable, "[sS]ample [0-9]*"))
g <- ggplot(specs.sm_melt, aes(x = wl, y = value, color = rep)) +
```

## Aggregate replicate spectra: mean

```{r, echo = F}
# look at spectra names
samp_names <- colnames(specs)[-1]
samp_groups <- str_extract(samp_names, '[a-zA-Z ]*')
# list out spectra types ordered in specs
#ftypes <- c(rep("black",10), rep( "white", 11),rep("yellow",10 ))

# aggregate replicates
feederspec <- aggspec(specs, by = samp_groups, FUN = mean)


kable(signif(feederspec[1:10,], digits = 6), 
      format.args = list(scientific = FALSE), 
      #col.names = c("Depth Sum"), 
format = "pipe")
```

## Visual model


```{r}
feederspec.sm <- aggspec(specs.sm, by = samp_groups, FUN = mean)
feederspec.sm <- feederspec.sm[feederspec.sm$wl > 299 & feederspec.sm$wl < 701, ]

vismod1 <- vismodel(feederspec.sm,
  visual = "bluetit", ##or change to 'all' or avg.v for visual range avg.uv also option
  achromatic = "bt.dc", #this is the blue tit visual simulator, ALSO THIS IS FOR A BLACK/WHITE SCALE....CHOROMATC FOR COLOR
  illum = "D65", #simulates the illumination of standard daylight
  trans = "bluetit",
  qcatch = "Qi",
  bkg = "ideal",
  vonkries = FALSE,
  scale = 1,
  relative = FALSE # we are using absolute measurements because the light source calibrates 
)
```



```{r}
summary(vismod1)[0]
```


## Visual model table

```{r, echo = F}
vms <- summary(vismod1)
kable(vms, 
      format.args = list(scientific = F),
format = "pipe")
```

## Without pre-grouping data


```{r}
specs.sm[specs.sm$wl < 400,-1] <- 0
vismod1 <- vismodel(specs.sm[specs.sm$wl > 299 & specs.sm$wl < 701,],
  visual = "bluetit", ##or change to 'all' or avg.v for visual range avg.uv also option
  achromatic = "bt.dc", #this is the blue tit visual simulator, ALSO THIS IS FOR A BLACK/WHITE SCALE....CHOROMATC FOR COLOR
  illum = "D65", #simulates the illumination of standard daylight
  trans = "bluetit",
  qcatch = "Qi",
  bkg = "ideal",
  vonkries = FALSE,
  scale = 1,
  relative = FALSE # we are using absolute measurements because the light source calibrates 
)

feederdist.bs <- bootcoldist(vismod1,
  by = samp_groups, 
  n = c(1,1.9,2.2,2.1),
  weber = 0.05, 
  weber.achro = 0.1 
)

kable(feederdist.bs, 
      format.args = list(scientific = F),
format = "pipe")

```


## stylized plot: means w/ errorbars

```{r, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, echo = F}
fs_df <- as.data.frame(feederdist.bs)
fs_df$comparison <- rownames(fs_df)

g <- ggplot(fs_df, aes(x=comparison, y = dS.mean)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept =1),lty=2, color = "grey") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dS.lwr, ymax = dS.upr, x = comparison), width = .2) +
  theme_prism(axis_text_angle = 45)
g
```

## Plot by B1

"***" dL > 3,

all other comparisons dL < 3

```{r, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, echo = F}
ssrn_p <- ssrn[-1,]
ssrn_p$group <- str_extract(rownames(ssrn_p), "[a-zA-Z ]*")
ssrn_p$sample <- rownames(ssrn_p)
ssrn_p$group <- factor(ssrn_p$group, levels = c("White Matte","White Shiny"))
ssrn_p$B1 <- as.numeric(ssrn_p$B1)

my_comparisons <- list( c("pol", "depol")
                        )


g <- ggplot(ssrn_p, aes(x=group, y = B1)) +
  #geom_hline(aes(yintercept =1),lty=2, color = "grey") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons,
                    ref.group = ".all.",
                     hide.ns = F,
                    #symnum.args = list(cutpoints = c(0,   0.05, Inf), 
                    #                   symbols = c("***",   "*")),
                     label = "p.signif") +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dL.lwr, ymax = dL.upr, x = comparison), width = .2) +
  theme_prism(axis_text_angle = 45)
g
```




## Barplot by B1

"***" dL > 3,

all other comparisons dL < 3

```{r, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 3, echo = F, warning=F}
ssrn_p <- ssrn[-1,]
ssrn_p$group <- str_extract(rownames(ssrn_p), "[a-zA-Z ]*")
ssrn_p$sample <- rownames(ssrn_p)
ssrn_p$group <- factor(ssrn_p$group, levels = unique(ssrn_p$group))
ssrn_p$B1 <- as.numeric(ssrn_p$B1)
ssrn_p$bw <- str_extract(rownames(ssrn_p), "[BW]")

my_comparisons <- list( c("White Matte", "White Shiny")
                        )


g <- ggplot(ssrn_p, aes(x=group, y = B1, fill = group)) +
  #geom_hline(aes(yintercept =1),lty=2, color = "grey") +
  #geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
  
  geom_errorbar(stat = 'summary', color = "grey",
                width = .5) +
  geom_bar( stat = 'summary', fun.y = 'mean',
            alpha = 1,
            width = .75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = list("White Matte" = "black", "White Shiny" = "dark grey"), guide = F) +
  #stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons,
  #                  symnum.args = list(cutpoints = c(0,   0.05, Inf), 
  #                                     symbols = c("ns",   "*")),
  #                  vjust = .5,
  #                   label = "p.signif") +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  xlab("")+ ylab("Brightness (B1)") +
  theme_prism(axis_text_angle = 45, base_fontface = "plain", base_line_size = .5)
g
```






## Plot by B1


a: 1 < dL < 3

```{r, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, echo = F}


g <- ggplot(ssrn_p, aes(x=group, y = B1)) +
  #geom_hline(aes(yintercept =1),lty=2, color = "grey") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(#comparisons = my_comparisons,
                    ref.group = ".all.", #blackUM",
                     #hide.ns = T,
                    method = "t.test",
                    symnum.args = list(cutpoints = c(0,   0.0019, Inf), 
                                       symbols = c("a",   "b")),
                    vjust = -1,
                     label = "p.signif") +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dL.lwr, ymax = dL.upr, x = comparison), width = .2) +
  theme_prism(axis_text_angle = 45)
g
```
